posts.title: Comparing Markdown Writing Apps
posts.description: A requirements-driven comparison of iA Writer, Typora, Calmly Writer, and MarkText for writing Hugo blog posts.

posts.title: Keep your Git history tidy and clean
posts.description: A hands-on demo of fixup commits that lets you attach a forgotten change to an earlier commit instead of piling up “oops” commits.

posts.title: Reducing the blast radius of running pi.dev
posts.description: A practical look at making Pi safer to use: isolating each project in a Tart-based virtual machine, sharing only the required directories, and using Pi extensions to block risky access patterns and destructive Git commands.
